note: Cases built from fixtures run through `orb validate --json` (the Rust check): random-bytes counts out of range, fractional and in range, wrong arity, closed option keys, credential requests (unknown field, missing required field, text, non-object, binding), nested calls. The collector answer is the HOST_CALLS_COLLECTED the shared collector gives for the same program.
